reference: Android MediaFormat.KEY_PRIORITY and KEY_IMPORTANCE; AOSP Android15 ResourceTracker same-app reclaim policy
finding: Default importance0 peers are excluded from normal same-process reclaim under the documented policy; no demonstrated current Cast-steals-phone defect. Importance1 would chiefly make Cast reclaimable by a later phone request; priority1 is a best-effort hint. Initialization occurs before configure applies preferences and OEM behavior remains unqualified.
decision: Keep the already verified per-instance configuration for this QA; do not add an unverified late performance-policy change to manufacture a guarantee. Existing actual pair configuration, sample-throughput, thermal and cancellation gates remain. Lower-importance recommendation retained for evidence-driven physical resource qualification.
